title: Machine Learning as an Economic Shield: Decision Support Forecasting of Agricultural Price Volatility for Smallholder Farmers in West Bengal
shortTitle: Machine Learning as an Economic Shield
description: A hyper-local machine learning framework for forecasting district-level crop prices in West Bengal, comparing ARIMA, XGBoost, and Random Forest. It identifies local price volatility and converts forecasts into threshold-based risk signals for proactive agricultural credit and policy support.
shortDescription: Decision Support Forecasting of Agricultural Price Volatility for Smallholder Farmers in West Bengal.

title: Multimodal Semantic Risk Engine: Assessing US Macroeconomic Stress via Historical Analogue Retrieval
description: A multimodal risk engine that takes a natural-language description of a current economic stress scenario and retrieves structurally similar events from a 1973–present historical database. It combines financial indicators with NYT news embeddings to identify the top 5 semantic analogues, classify their economic regime, and examine subsequent S&P 500 volatility and maximum drawdown.
shortDescription: Historical analogue retrieval for understanding macroeconomic stress.

title: Fear, Volatility, and Market Segmentation: Evidence of Asymmetric Spillovers in Indian Equity Markets Using Hybrid CNN–LSTM Models
description: The study examines how market fear, represented by India VIX, influences volatility across different segments of the Indian equity market. Using daily data from 2020–2025 and a hybrid CNN–LSTM framework, the study finds that India VIX can anticipate future market volatility, with mid-cap and small-cap stocks showing stronger and more persistent reactions to fear-driven shocks.
shortDescription: Evidence of Asymmetric Spillovers in Indian Equity Markets Using Hybrid CNN–LSTM Models.

title: The Interwoven Factors that Shape the Performance of an Indian Student – An Analysis
shortTitle: Factors Behind Performance of an Indian Student
description: This study examines the factors that shape student performance and well-being in India, considering living arrangements, dietary habits, self-care routines, commuting behaviors, and entertainment consumption. Using a dataset collected across different ages and educational backgrounds, the research explores the multifaceted factors associated with academic success and the changing Indian student experience.
shortDescription: A study of how lifestyle and daily habits shape student performance and well-being in India.

title: Data Edification: Navigating Insights with an Interactive Dashboard
description: A user-friendly data exploration platform where users can upload datasets, preprocess and clean them, perform basic EDA, and create interactive visualizations without extensive coding knowledge. It supports missing-value imputation, duplicate removal, correlation analysis, regression, K-means clustering, and a wide range of interactive charts.
shortDescription: Navigating Insights with an Interactive Dashboard.
